title: ChadSwap
tagline: ChadSwap utilizing smart dynamic routing LP for DeFi and CeFi for verified users.
description:
ChadSwap acting as DEX and CEX aggregator and in order to use CEX liquidity wallet should have BAB token linked to it.  
ChadSwap aggregates RFQ  from CEX and DEX. Dex swiping  is going via 1inch Fusion. In case user choose CEX option based on his linked identity his order will be swap on Binance or other CEX. This option would be enable if user has BAB token. 
KYC check for user address is done via knowyourcat.id which onchain aggregator for KYC. Since Settlement can be fully or partially via CEX what is taking time, funds from smart dynamic routing LP would be use for temporary  borrowing funds and sent the user and later settle transaction with CEX.   
Protocol is deployed on Linea, Polygon, Mantle
